author: Sara Kim
alert_description: edge-gateway 5xx rate is 11.5% across all routes (threshold 5%)

trigger.summary: node group ng-general-aps1 scaled 6 -> 11 nodes (pending pods: 23)
trigger.author: cluster-autoscaler

details.diff: scale-up triggered by 23 unschedulable pods after the nightly batch job fan-out

discriminators: many services report DNS lookup errors from the same minute
ledger-svc also fails name resolution (not one service's problem)
CoreDNS latency is in the seconds and it is CPU-bound
lookups time out against the cluster DNS service IP
the node group scaled up just before the errors started

steps.note: scaled CoreDNS 2 -> 6 and planned NodeLocal DNSCache

migration_context: 4 days after the PgBouncer migration (M1, 3 Sep)
